# GenerativeBorder

The border that shows the AI is generating content: a 2px rounded stroke in two flat colors, in hard-edged segments that run clockwise around the edge. - **isActive** shows the ring and sets `aria-busy` on the wrapper. Off, the children render inside the wrapper with no ring at all. - **radius** names the radius token the ring follows; match the content it wraps. Defaults to `radius-100`. The segments turn slowly while active. The ring is decorative and hidden from assistive technology; `aria-busy` is what says content is changing. Under reduced motion the same segments hold still. Use it only while generating, one ring per piece of content. Do not nest two.

**Import:** `import { GenerativeBorder } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/loading/GenerativeBorder/GenerativeBorder.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/loading/GenerativeBorder/GenerativeBorder.stories.jsx` — Idle, Generating, ReducedMotion, Radii, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused

**Motion:** change `linear` · pulse `loop`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations › Expression › Motion.

## Usage

Use `GenerativeBorder` only while the AI is generating into a piece of content, one ring per piece. It is never decoration, and two must not nest. For other waits, use `Spinner` or `Skeleton`.

## Motion

GenerativeBorder reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Load content | `--ds-motion-linear` | Its light travels while the AI drafts and stops when done. |
| pulse | Load content | `--ds-motion-loop` | A pulse uses the loop. |

## Best practices

### Animate one thing at a time. {#animate-one-thing-at-a-time}

One moving border keeps attention on the content being generated.

Do: One active border.
Don't: Every border active.

### Match the radius to the pattern. {#match-the-radius-to-the-pattern}

The border traces the content's corners; a pill around a rectangular card looks detached.

Do: Radius that matches the content.
Don't: A pill around a rectangle.

### Stop animating when the work ends. {#stop-animating-when-the-work-ends}

Set `isActive` to false when generation ends.

Do: Inactive once done.
Don't: Still animating after completion.

### Use one ring per piece of content. {#use-one-ring-per-piece-of-content}

Do: One ring around the content being generated.
Don't: Two rings nested around the same content.

## Accessibility

- **`aria-busy` says content is changing.** The wrapper sets it from `isActive`; the ring itself is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
- **Reduced motion.** The ring keeps its colors without moving; see States above.

## Related

- For the icons that start an AI action, use `AiIcon`.
- For a general wait, use `Spinner`, `Skeleton` or `ProgressBar`.

Same group: `ProgressBar` · `ProgressRing` · `Skeleton` · `Spinner`

## Parts

1. **Content.** The content being generated, unchanged by the border.
2. **Ring.** A stroke over the edge while `isActive`, so layout never moves. Its 2-unit width comes from `--border-selected`.
3. **Segments.** Four hard-edged, flat segments alternating brand and discovery colors.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | Idle: no ring. `aria-busy` is false. |
| Generating | The ring alternates clockwise and counterclockwise turns on the `--ds-motion-loop` spring. Each turn takes `--ds-motion-loop-duration` (600 ms). `aria-busy` is true. |
| Reduced motion | The ring holds still and keeps its colors, so the generating state remains visible. |
| Hovered | None. It is not a control. |
| Pressed | None. |
| Focused | None. It is not in the tab order. |
| Disabled | None. The border has no disabled state. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Segments | `--ds-border-brand` and `--ds-border-discovery`. |
| Stroke | `--border-selected`, through `--generative-border-width`. |
| Corner | `--generative-border-radius`, set to the radius token named by `radius`: `--radius-025`, `--radius-050`, `--radius-075`, `--radius-100`, `--radius-full`, or a control radius (`--radius-control-sm`, `--radius-control-md`, `--radius-control-lg`) to follow a field. |
| Turn | `--generative-border-angle`, from a rest of `--generative-border-rest`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Say what is being made beside the border: "Drafting the session summary…". | Show the border with no text about what is happening. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `isActive` | bool | `false` | Whether content is being generated. Shows the ring and sets `aria-busy`. |
| `radius` | enum | `'radius-100'` | The radius token the ring follows. Match the wrapped content. |
| `children` | node | — | The content being generated into. |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
| `style` | object | — | — |
